products.title: Sherwood x Dormie Ball Marker
products.body_html:
Sherwood x Dormie Ball Marker

 

Every Canadian knows the two dollar coin: a silver ring around a gold center that's been rattling around in pockets for decades. We borrowed that look and made it a ball marker.

The Sherwood x Dormie Ball Marker carries the Sherwood Hockey S and 1949, the year Sherwood started building hockey gear, on one face. Flip it over and you'll find the Dormie Workshop tap in icon and 2014, the year we opened our shop in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Two Canadian brands share one marker for your pocket.

At 1 1/4 inches across, it's easy to spot on the green and easy to pick up. It arrives in a gift coin box, ready for the golfer in your life who grew up at the rink.

It's part of North of Par, our collaboration with Sherwood Hockey. It's a limited run, and once they're gone, they're gone.
